texts.preamble: ) Sri. Subramani S/O Late ... vs ) State Of Karnataka By on 14 March, 2022 In The Court Of The Xiii Addl.City Civil & Sessions Judge Mayohall Unit: Bengaluru. (Cch:22) Present: - Smt. Suvarna K. Mirji, B.Com., LL.B.[Spl] Xiii Addl. City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru. Dated this the 14th day of March 2022
texts.facts: The appellant/accused has preferred this appeal U/sec 374(3) of Cr.PC praying to [LEAKAGE_MASK] the Judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the X ACMM, Mayohall Unit, Bengaluru in CC.No.23261/2010 on 07/02/2018 for an offence punishable Judgment Crl. A. No.25022/2018 U/s 420 of IPC and Sec.7 & 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954. 2. The appellant is accused and respondent is complainant before court below. The rank of both parties are referred as referred before the court below. 3. The brief facts of prosecution/respondent case is as under:- The complainant/CW.1 received credible information about manufacturing of adulterated ghee and selling the same on 19/06/2010 at about 6-45 p.m. and that he and his staff proceeded and reached around 7-10 p.m at No.2, 3 rd Cross, Car Street, Halasuru, Bengaluru and found one goods auto in front of the house and the driver was transporting the oil tins from the auto to the house and on enquiry he informed that on the advise of accused he is doing so and after entering into the house premises Judgment Crl. A. No.25022/2018 he found accused who admitted that the said godawan belongs to him and that the CW.1 alleged to have enquired the appellant regarding vanaspathi and other articles in the godown and initially the appellant did not give proper answer and later on he admitted that he is ) Sri. Subramani S/O Late ... vs ) State Of Karnataka By on 14 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142786550/ 1 manufacturing the adulterated ghee by mixing cooking oil, vanaspathi and fragrance and manufacturing duplicate ghee and knowingly fully well that it was adulterated ghee was selling the same in the open market under the brand Sri Krishna Ghee and New Radha Krishna Pure Ghee without any valid license and permit and thereby accused cheated the public and thereby committed an offences punishable U/s 420 of IPC and Sec.7 & 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954. 4. The trial court taken cognizance against accused for an offence punishable U/s 420 of IPC and Sec.7 & 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954. The trial court framed the charge against the accused and accused denied the same and claims to be Judgment Crl. A. No.25022/2018 tried. The prosecution examined witnesses PW.1 to PW.4 and marked ExP1 to ExP8(a) and MO.1 to MO.4 and thereafter trial court recorded statement of accused U/s 313 of Cr.PC, the accused denied the same and submitted no defence evidence. Aggrieved by the said conviction Judgment the accused/appellant preferred the present appeal on the following grounds.
texts.arguments: The appellant/accused submits that the magistrate has committed error in taking cognizance of the offence and as such the conviction is bad in law. The magistrate erred in accepting and acting upon Evidence of Prosecution which is being inadmissible. The evidence taken by the magistrate is manifestly erroneous and argument employed by magistrate for convicting the appellant utterly unsustainable in law.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The appellant/accused submits that the magistrate has committed error in taking cognizance of the offence and as such the conviction is bad in law. The magistrate erred in accepting and acting upon Evidence of Prosecution which is being inadmissible. The evidence taken by the magistrate is manifestly erroneous and argument employed by magistrate for convicting the appellant utterly unsustainable in law.
